title: Blogging Platform
description: A high-performance digital notes and technical publishing platform featuring deep-dive articles on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and web engineering.
longDescription: A clean, distraction-free digital garden and technical knowledge base built with Next.js, MDX, and Tailwind CSS. Organizes in-depth programming tutorials and conceptual breakdowns—from Artificial Intelligence fundamentals and Neural Networks to modern React architectures—with interactive code snippets, instant copy-to-clipboard, reading bookmarks, and search.
